format: html

## Load Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(glmnet)
library(bestglm)
library(ggfortify)
library(car)   
library(corrplot)  
library(GGally)
```

## Where we obtained the data

[Happiness URL](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/unsdsn/world-happiness?select=2019.csv)

## Read in Data

```{r}
happy <- read.csv("Happiness.csv")
```

## Matrix scatterplot

```{r}
happy_num <- happy # Getting rid of categorical data so I can plot this
happy_num$Country.or.region <- NULL
happy_num$Overall.rank <- NULL
plot(happy_num, upper.panel=NULL)
```

```{r}
corrplot(cor(happy_num))
```
